question: Waymo rides are booked for you by a person on the sirven team (a concierge). To get a price and book, they will see your pickup (535 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105), where you are going (Mission Street Barbers, 2400 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110), and when (2:50pm to 3:05pm). They will not see your calendar or anything else about you. If you book, they pay with the one-time card for this ride, which they see only as its last four digits and its limit. Is that all right?
